notes.title: Get ready to kick some ass!
notes.content:
Good day Degenheim Fam!
Even though many of you have already noticed, the new and updated Demo has been lowkey out in the wild for a couple of months now, which helped us to collect further data and feedback. We are now officially announcing it, as we are happy with the current state of the game..
So, what’s the Demo about, and what is new in our latest version 0.3.3? Here’s the digestible breakdown:

[u][b]Demo Content –[/b][/u]
This Demo features 3 out of the total 10 chapters, each chapter is associated with chapter-specific unlockable ability pools, unique mini-bosses and bosses, environments and enemies. You will have 7 out of total 22 unhinged heroes to unlock (we originally planned a roster of 20, but sometimes you just have to vent the creativity, or perhaps insanity), a fully functional online 4-player co-op, 5 game difficulties for the masochists, and a leaderboard to bolster the good ‘ole competitive spirit. And of course, we just had to add new (freaking 7 thus far) game events that randomly spawn in levels to stir the pot a bit, like exploding poop or spitting toilets. Yeah, hard to explain, you better see for yourself. Oh, and did we mention 14 new abilities you can further customize your playstyle with and literally meme on your friends? ‘Cuz yeah, that got in too. With this, we will also be saying bye to our long-running closed-beta Playtest, bon voyage, and cheers to the new chapter!

[u][b]Detailed Changes –[/b][/u]
[b]Levels:[/b]
- First 3 chapters’ environments got visual overhauls

[b]Items:[/b]
- Revamped how Item forging works (you now always need 3 items of the same type and rarity to forge a higher tier)
- Revamped how Item stats work (your bonuses from rank 1 and rank 2 abilities are now cumulative) 

[b]Support & Fixes:[/b]
- Complete controller scheme overhaul
- The new scheme should now be fully compatible with Xbox/PS5 controllers
- The new scheme should now be fully compatible with SteamDeck and other Handhelds
- Significantly changed and improved how Ranged and AOE abilities are targeted when using controllers (you can either tap to cast on the nearest enemy, or hold to manually aim)
- Added useful hints on screen allowing for immediate interaction recognition
- Significantly improved controller UI navigation
- Significantly improved controller Hovers recognition and visibility
- Tweaked Handhelds’ display ratios
- Tweaked Ultra-wide monitors’ ratios
- Enabled always-on Servers to reduce the loading times
- Fixed multiple instances of incorrect Audio and Sound Effects
- Significantly improved the hints on and functionality of Co-Op connectivity and Game Invites

[b]Game Balance:[/b]
- Attic Knight’s HP increased
- Finetuned damage values on Bleed and Agony builds
- Added a helluva lot more enemies to stages (community asked, we listened)
- Finetuned damage values of several abilities like Dashes and Meteors

[b]Content:[/b]
- Added Nora, a new unlockable hero
- Added Donald Pump, a new unlockable hero
- Added completely new mini-bosses to Chapters 2 and 3
- Added 14 "Memesake" abilities usable with any hero available at new NPC in HUB
- Added Leaderboard NPC to Player HUB where the bloody competitions can begin
- Added 5 Game Difficulties from an absolute cakewalk to a punishing nightmare
- Added 7 new Game Events that randomly spawn during runs to ruin your life
- Added the ability Reroll function
- Added 3rd card that spawns in the Vendor room with plenty of new juicy modifiers 
- Added Damage Display for ALL players to the Win/Loss Screen so you know who the carry is
- Further revamped what information displays on Win/Loss screen for better clarity
- Added Difficulty Display to levels
- Added the Picked-up Abilities expandable menu to levels
- Added a collection of Arts as new Loading Screens
- Revamped VFX on several abilities to make them more visually pleasing

We would like to sincerely thank all of you for being a part of this journey and for the patience you have with us. The development process of Degenheim has been a wild roller coaster, and we had plenty of ups and downs, but now that we are in the final stretch, we hope you will enjoy this sample of our mad little world. We still have a bunch of features to implement together with the remaining chapters and heroes, so sit tight and brace yourselves. The most derailed and degenerated Roguelike is soon at your doorsteps.

[u][b]LET THE GAMES BEGIN[/b][/u]

Truly yours,
Team Degenheim!
